blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of the fresh V133 front, back, side, three-quarter and neutral images shows a smooth flared shell with jagged panel ridges, not a clearly readable repeated pleat pattern. Required action: revise sewn-panel geometry so folds read consistently in all required views.

Fresh V133 front and side views retain a projecting waist-level shelf at the skirt attachment; rear views also show uneven overlap. Required action: remove the shelf and make the upper skirt edge follow the torso/waist contour continuously.

Fresh V133 crouch and sit images show exposed shorts/thigh regions and bunching or dangling skirt panels; prone remains a broad rigid-looking mass. Patchy torso/back interference is also visible. Required action: correct clearance and deformation at sewn-panel level, then regenerate and inspect all eleven views.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
